_comment: OCSR specialist models. All four install into ChemGraph's own environment; see examples/ocsr/README.md. accuracy is exact match over the 722-image benchmark (n=722 for each). import_name is what ocsr_backends probes to decide whether a model is installed. weights is where a checkpoint is cached; DECIMER manages its own cache and has none.

decimer.note: Most accurate of the four, and the only one on PyPI. The default.

molnextr.note: Second by exact match. Needs the timm compatibility shim.

ocsrglyph.note: Fastest of the four. Lowest exact match on this benchmark.
